## What problem does this solve?

Describe the user problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue when useful.

## Evidence and scope

For research or factual changes, link the primary source and state what you reviewed and what remains uncertain. Do not present software tests as scientific validation.

## Checks performed

List the exact tests or manual checks run. For a data-loss or correctness fix, include the regression check. For website changes, include generated-site/link checks and a narrow-screen check.

## Rights, privacy and safety

- [ ] I have the rights to contribute these changes and have recorded third-party license/provenance where relevant.
- [ ] I did not include raw recordings, participant data, credentials, personal paths or sensitive wildlife locations.
- [ ] I have not enabled animal playback, real-data intake or a scientific claim without the required review.
- [ ] I disclosed substantive AI assistance and checked the resulting sources, behavior and code.

## Public release boundary

- [ ] I kept `dist/`, private workspace data, local configuration and funding drafts out of this change.
- [ ] I understand that passing CI does not deploy the website or establish a scientific result.
